assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these intermittent symptoms with potential arrhythmias and assess the efficacy of current rate-control management.
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10).
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0).

This diagnostic monitoring is directly consistent with SilverBridge Advantage's requirement that non-emergency diagnostic monitoring services be pre-approved to ensure medical necessity and coverage eligibility.
